engine: Interactive EXPLODED AXONOMETRIC of a building: on entry the building separates into N labelled component planes (e.g. Вінець / Пергола / Фасад / Основа) via translateY + a small sideways parallax-x + per-step scale, staggered, ease 'air'. Hover/click/focus a plane ISOLATES it (lifts forward + brightens) while the others recede + dim + blur (filter); a spec panel reveals that component's material + role. Mouse-leave / Esc re-assembles. Reads the building the way an architect pulls a model apart, layer by layer.
law: transform/opacity/filter + GSAP only; GPU-composited; NO WebGL, NO canvas, NO mix-blend, NO backdrop-filter. owns_pin false (hover/click, no scroll). Each layer image MUST be the component its label names (asset-truth) and MUST be visually distinct from the others (no two near-identical shots). gap >= plane height so planes do not overlap (overlapping planes make hover hit the wrong layer). reduced-motion / narrow -> a static labelled stack list. Sets window.__LAB_OK__.

layers.what: [{img, label, spec}] top-to-bottom component planes. img = a render of THAT component (distinct per layer); label = the part name; spec = one Fedoriv line on material + role.

gap.what: vertical distance between adjacent exploded planes; set >= plane height so slabs read separated and hover regions never overlap.

parallaxX.what: sideways drift per layer as it separates (depth).

scaleStep.what: per-layer scale falloff from the middle (depth).

entry: ExplodedStackInspect.create(target, {layers, gap, parallaxX, scaleStep, accent}) -> { isolate(i), release(), destroy }. target = the stage; the engine builds one .esi-layer per layers[] entry (img + label) + a spec panel; wires hover/click/focus isolate + mouse-leave/Esc release.
